name: Rammus
title: the Armordillo

Q.name: Powerball
Q.description: Rammus curls into a ball, gaining (0.25–0.391 (by level)) × 1 Move Speed, accelerating up to ((0.25–0.391 (by level)) × 1) × 6 Move Speed over 6 seconds. Rammus stops after colliding with an enemy, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 + 1×AP magic damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing nearby enemies by 40/50/60/70/80% for 1 second. Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.
Q.summary: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

W.name: Defensive Ball Curl
W.description: Rammus enters a defensive formation for 7 seconds, gaining (25/30/35/40/45 × (1 + 0.3/0.35/0.4/0.45/0.5)) + 0.3/0.35/0.4/0.45/0.5×armor Armor and (20/25/30/35/40 × (1 + 0.3/0.35/0.4/0.45/0.5)) + 0.3/0.35/0.4/0.45/0.5×MR Magic Resist and dealing 15 + 0.1×armor + 0.1×MR magic damage to enemies that Attack him. Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.
W.summary: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.

E.name: Frenzying Taunt
E.description: Rammus Taunts an enemy champion or monster for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds. Monsters are dealt 80/100/120/140/160 + 0.7×AP magic damage.
E.summary: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.

R.name: Soaring Slam
R.description: Rammus hops into the air and slams down in an area, dealing 150/250/350 + 0.6×AP magic damage and Slowing by 30/40/50% for 1.5 seconds. If used during Powerball, enemies in the center take an additional @spell.PowerBall:PowerBallDamage@ magic damage and are Knocked Up for 0.75 seconds. Rammus then creates 3 aftershocks in the area over 3.5 seconds, repeating the Slow. The range of this Ability is increased by Rammus's Move Speed.
R.summary: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.

Passive.name: Spiked Shell
Passive.description: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.
Passive.summary: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Armored tank jungler who rolls into ganks with Q. Wins fights by taunting carries with E and punishing attack champions with W armor.
strengths: Q roll knocks back and slows on collision
W armor and magic resist; reflects damage on attackers
R slam slows and knocks up in Powerball
weaknesses: Weak against magic damage and % health

Passive.notes: Bonus attack damage from armor and magic resist.

W.notes: Armor and magic resist; damages attackers.

R.notes: Slam; knock-up if used during Powerball.
